search_text: published ZDI-23-677 ZDI-CAN-19279 Delta Electronics InfraSuite Device Master CtrlLayerNWCmd_ReportFileOperation Directory Traversal Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2023-05-17 CVE-2023-1134 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-1134 6.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N ['Delta Electronics'] ['InfraSuite Device Master'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Delta Electronics InfraSuite Device Master. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the CtrlLayerNWCmd_ReportFileOperation function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise. Delta Electronics has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Delta Electronics InfraSuite Device Master CtrlLayerNWCmd_ReportFileOperation Directory Traversal Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Delta Electronics InfraSuite Device Master. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the CtrlLayerNWCmd_ReportFileOperation function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise.
